race.comment: TOO DARN STORMY (3) comes here after a short break and has been readied with one trial. He was in good form last campaign without winning, running strong figures in defeat. He looks well placed in this grade, Fiore and Morton are teaming up well recently, and he finds the right race to return a winner. MAI ALOHA (5) was too good from the front last start when going back to the midweeks and scoring by a head. This is tougher, but she's a solid type who will make her own luck up on the speed. Can fire across and be tough to reel in. SUNSET SESSION (10) won impressively two back before missing in a photo finish last start at 1200m. Back to 1000m is a query, but CJP sticks with him and his recent form makes for good reading. ETERNAL WINE (7) may get back in the run but watch for her flying late in the race. LAST STYLEBENDER (4) has to be included after a good effort last time out.
